displayName: Suspicious Exchange Online Inbox Forwarding or Hiding Rule Created

queryCondition.queryText:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
| extend RuleData = tostring(RawEventData)
| where RuleData has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "MarkAsRead", "MoveToFolder")
| where RuleData has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardingSmtpAddress", "RSS Feeds", "Deleted Items", "Conversation History")
| project Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, ActionType, IPAddress, CountryCode, RuleData, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious Exchange Online Inbox Forwarding or Hiding Rule Created
alertTemplate.description: Detects creation or modification of Exchange Online inbox rules that forward email externally or hide messages in RSS or Deleted Items folders following credential phishing. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-russian-state-phishing-zimbra.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the mailbox rule parameters, check recent sign-ins for the user account, remove unauthorised forwarding rules, and revoke active refresh tokens (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504; Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-russian-state-phishing-zimbra).
